ValidationRule.description: When parent oppty is selected as local currency (non USD), the child oppty must use the same currency as parent
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.Bypass_VR__c = FALSE, $Profile.Name != "Xendit API Profile", RecordType.Name = "Child Opportunity", AND(NOT(ISNULL(Parent_Opportunity__c)), Parent_Opportunity__c != 'null', NOT(ISBLANK(Parent_Opportunity__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Parent_Opportunity__r.CurrencyIsoCode))),NOT(ISPICKVAL(Parent_Opportunity__r.CurrencyIsoCode, "USD"))), TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) != TEXT(Parent_Opportunity__r.CurrencyIsoCode) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select the same currency as Parent Opportunity
